This '''militiaman''' warned [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] about the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].

==Biography==
While Biggs Darklighter, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and a couple other friends were flying their [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]] inside [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]], this militia scout crashed his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] on the sand dunes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. As Darklighter tried to help him, he warned the folks of Tusken Raiders who chased him earlier. A [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt destroyed one of the T-16 skyhoppers and all the friends hid behind rocks firing back at the Tusken Raiders.<ref name="MSW17" />
